from.n: view-push > Session > shows the output in a dialog as tall as the screen, a carriage return starting a line over

to.n: view-push > Session > shows the output in a dialog shrunk to fit the screen, a carriage return starting a line over

from.n: view-push > Session > wraps a line wider than the dialog, keeping all of it

to.n: view-push > Session > wraps a line wider than the dialog after its last space that fits, breaking a word wider than the dialog

from.n: view-push > runPager() > creating the pull request > gives the created pull request's address in the dialog, saying it is quitting, for half a second before it quits

to.n: view-push > runPager() > creating the pull request > gives the created pull request's address in the dialog, saying it is quitting, for two seconds before it quits

from.n: view-push > runPager() > landing > gives the merged pull request's address in the dialog, saying it is quitting, for half a second before it quits, when the settings say to

to.n: view-push > runPager() > landing > gives the merged pull request's address in the dialog, saying it is quitting, for two seconds before it quits, when the settings say to

from.n: view-push > Session > asking whether to push > asks under what the task found, emphasized, offering Push and Cancel with no button as its default

to.n: view-push > Session > asking whether to push > asks under what the task found, offering Push and Cancel with no button as its default

from.n: view-push > pushBranch() > runs nothing on the branch origin names as its default

to.n: view-push > pushBranch() > runs nothing on the branch origin's server names as its default, whatever git cached on cloning

from.n: view-push > pushBranch() > runs nothing when origin names no default branch

to.n: view-push > pushBranch() > runs nothing when origin's server names no default branch, even when git cached one

from.n: view-push > pushBranch() > returns what `ask` returns, given how origin's branch stands, and runs nothing, when origin already has the branch

to.n: view-push > pushBranch() > returns what `ask` returns, given how origin's branch stands and origin's default branch, and runs nothing, when origin already has the branch
